pages.title: Foliot Janitor
pages.text: The janitor will pick up dropped items and deposit them into a target$(br)inventory.$(br)If the filter slot is empty, the janitor will pick up everything in its work area.$(br)Put a $(item)list filter$() or $(item)attribute filter$() into its filter slot to control $()

pages.title: Foliot Janitor
pages.text: which items it picks up instead.$(br)See Spirit Filters for filter details and recipes.$(br)

To bind the janitor to an inventory simply sneak and interact$(br)with the janitor book of calling on that inventory. You can$(br)also interact with a block while holding the janitor book of$(br)calling to have it deposit items $()
there. You can also have it$(br)wander around a select area by pulling up that interface.$(br)

pages.title: Pro tip
pages.text: The Janitor will pick up crushed items from a $(l:summoning_rituals/summon_crusher_t1)Crusher$(/l), $(l:summoning_rituals/summon_smelter_t1)Smelter$(/l), $(l:summoning_rituals/summon_crystallizer_t1)Crystallizer$(/l)$(br)spirits and deposit them into a chest.$(br2)Combine that with a $(l:summoning_rituals/summon_transport_items)Transporter Spirit$(/l) to automate the whole process.$(br)

pages.title: Usage
pages.text: Use the book of calling to set the work area and deposit location of the janitor.$(br2) $(br) See Books of Calling for more information.$(br)
